newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady Friday amid featureless activity, dealers said.
In the Southeast, the focus was on the harvesting of soft red winter wheat. "We are in the middle of the wheat harvest," a North Carolina dealer said.
He noted flour mills were buying more wheat and making flour sales. The feed mills were also buying more wheat in their rations. But this happens during this time of year, he said.
The harvest of hard red winter wheat was a concern in the Kansas/Oklahoma market, a Kansas dealer said. "It's hot and dry and it's perfect harvest weather," he said.
But the Minneapolis market may see better flour mill runtimes ahead of the July 4 Independence Day holiday, a dealer said.
